macros.name: mathfrak
macros.doc: The euler package defines two new math alphabet identifiers, \mathscr (Euler Script, uppercase letters only) and \mathfrak (Euler Fraktur, both lowercase and uppercase letters).

macros.name: mathscr
macros.doc: The euler package defines two new math alphabet identifiers, \mathscr (Euler Script, uppercase letters only) and \mathfrak (Euler Fraktur, both lowercase and uppercase letters).

macros.name: scr
macros.doc: For compatibility with previous versions of the euler package, we define \scr as an alias for \mathscr.
